subject: Phased cutover & negotiation plan for observability renewals (logs retention)
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, elena.varela@grafana.com, sales@datadog.com, jordan.park@getsentry.com
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Phased cutover & negotiation plan for observability renewals (logs retention)

Team + vendor partners —

Quick summary: three renewals coming up in September for Datadog (infra + logs), Grafana Cloud (logs retention add-on), and Sentry (event retention). Current blended spend for logging/observability is projected to increase ~28% under current terms. We need a mitigation plan that preserves critical SLO telemetry but reduces retention-driven spend by at least 35% for Q4.

Proposed approach (high level):
- Phase 1 (by 9/15): finalize vendor discounts & retention tiers for the next 12 months.
- Phase 2 (9/16–10/7): implement retention tiering + prefix-based log routing (hot vs cold) for non-prod and low-value routes.
- Phase 3 (10/8–10/31): validate metrics ingestion and paging alerts; fall back plan ready for 24–48h.

Asks:
1) Laura — can you confirm cost delta for 12/24/36 month terms with Datadog and Grafana given a 40% drop in retained volume? Attach model if possible.
2) Marissa — procurement readiness: what lead time do we need for DocuSign/PO routing for each vendor? Any vendor-specific tickboxes?
3) Vendors — Elena / Datadog / Jordan: can you provide a firm written price contemplative of the phased cutover and any migration credits?

I’ve attached initial quotes I have (dd_quote_Q3.pdf, grafana_pricing_v2.xlsx, sentry_retention_addon.pdf). Aim: finalize commercial terms by 9/10 so engineering can schedule the cutover windows.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, elena.varela@grafana.com, sales@datadog.com, jordan.park@getsentry.com
Date: 2026-08-19T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phased cutover & negotiation plan for observability renewals (logs retention)

Markus & all —

I pulled the numbers and attached a short model (see grafana_pricing_v2.xlsx). Key takeaways:
- If we move 60% of dev/staging logs to 7-day retention and keep 90% of prod at current levels, estimated spend reduction is ~38% across vendors.
- Datadog is offering a 12% baseline discount for committed spend > $250k/yr; they will consider additional credits for migration of historical indexes.
- Grafana Cloud’s retention add-on has a steeper marginal curve; asking them to match a blended price will be the hardest ask.

Questions for vendors: what is the minimum contract term to get the aggressive pricing (12 vs 24 vs 36 months)? Any technical constraints on prefix-based routing or exports to cold storage?

Next steps for internal team:
- I’ll publish a redlined cost sheet by 8/21.
- Marissa: if you can confirm PO timing, we’ll align purchase timing with vendor windows.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Manager, Cloud Economics | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, elena.varela@grafana.com, sales@datadog.com, jordan.park@getsentry.com
Date: 2026-08-20T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phased cutover & negotiation plan for observability renewals (logs retention)

Thanks — Marissa from Procurement here. Quick notes on timelines and gating items:

- DocuSign + standard PO flow: we need the signed SOW and any commercial terms 7 business days before the invoice/contract effective date. If we want 9/1 effective, signatures needed by 8/21 close of business.
- For enterprise discounts or credits we usually require a short addendum outlining migration credit conditions (timeboxed, not cumulative with other promos).
- If vendors require SOC2/dataflow attestations, route to Security (cc’d Hannah) — that can add ~5 business days.

Vendor asks for procurement: please provide a single PDF SOW and a separate pricing exhibit (so legal can track changes easier). We prefer line-item breakouts for retention tiers.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Varela <elena.varela@grafana.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: sales@datadog.com, jordan.park@getsentry.com
Date: 2026-08-21T15:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phased cutover & negotiation plan for observability renewals (logs retention)

Hi Markus/Laura/Marissa/Hannah —

Thanks for the clear plan. Grafana Cloud can do a provisional offer: 20% off the retention add-on for a 24-month commit and 8 weeks of export-to-cold-storage credits (to help with index migration). We will provide a draft SOW + pricing exhibit by end of day 8/24.

Notes/constraints:
- Prefix-based routing is supported, but we’ll need a short validation window (48–72h) after the routing rule is active to ensure dashboard continuity.
- For the pricing to apply we need a committed baseline (average monthly ingress) and the final SOW signed.

We’ll include the export job templates and the runbook for validating alert fidelity in the SOW. Happy to join the technical cutover call if helpful.

Best,
Elena Varela
Enterprise Renewals Lead | Grafana Cloud
